title: TrustRadius Reviews Scraper

startUrls.title: TrustRadius product URLs
startUrls.description: TrustRadius product or reviews URLs to scrape. Each must look like https://www.trustradius.com/products/{slug}/reviews (product root URLs are normalized). Provide this OR productSlugs OR searchQuery.

productSlugs.title: Product slugs
productSlugs.description: TrustRadius product slugs without the full URL, e.g. slack or hubspot. Provide this OR startUrls OR searchQuery.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Product name or keyword to search on TrustRadius, then scrape matching products. Free text such as Slack or CRM. Provide this OR startUrls OR productSlugs.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Upper bound on reviews extracted per product (1-5000). Defaults to 50. Prefill uses 1 for a cheap health check.

maxProductsPerSearch.title: Max products per search
maxProductsPerSearch.description: In search mode, how many matching products to take (1-100). Defaults to 5. Ignored for startUrls/productSlugs.

includeReviews.title: Scrape reviews in search mode
includeReviews.description: When true (default), search mode scrapes reviews for each matched product. When false, search returns product cards only (product-found billing).

includeProductSummary.title: Include product summary row (URL mode)
includeProductSummary.description: When true and includeReviews is false, URL/slug mode may emit a product card. Leave false for review-only runs.

sortReviewsBy.title: Sort reviews by
sortReviewsBy.description: TrustRadius sort before the per-product cap: newest maps to most-recent; helpful maps to most-helpful.

starRating.title: Star rating filter (1-5)
starRating.description: Optional market-style 1-5 star filter mapped to TrustRadius 0-10 bands (5 stars approx 8-10). Empty means no filter.

companySize.title: Company size filter
companySize.description: Optional reviewer company-size filter: small / medium / large (best-effort from public firmographics).

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.description: When true, writes a first-page diagnostic dump to the key-value store. Leave off for normal runs.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
